mapper.select: SELECT log.id, log.report_id, log.operator_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(operator_user.nickname, ''), NULLIF(operator_user.name, ''), operator_user.cas_id) AS operator_name, log.operation_type, log.decision, log.before_status, log.after_status, log.reason, log.actions_json, log.result_json, log.report_version, log.created_at FROM report_operation_log log LEFT JOIN `user` operator_user ON operator_user.id = log.operator_id WHERE log.report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY log.created_at DESC, log.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
